source.question: What are the valid e-mail addresses of the administrator of the school located in the San Bernardino county, City of San Bernardino City Unified that opened between 1/1/2009 to 12/31/2010 whose school types are public Intermediate/Middle Schools and Unified Schools?

decision_objective.summary: Return the administrator e-mail addresses recorded for schools satisfying all stated location, opening-period, and classification conditions.

target_population.entity_description: Schools in San Bernardino County and the city of San Bernardino, opened from 1 January 2009 through 31 December 2010, that are both public intermediate/middle schools and unified schools under the two stated business classifications.

inclusion_conditions.subject: school county
inclusion_conditions.description: The school's county is San Bernardino.

inclusion_conditions.subject: school city
inclusion_conditions.description: The school's city is San Bernardino.

inclusion_conditions.business_concept: public intermediate or middle school classification
inclusion_conditions.subject: public intermediate or middle school classification
inclusion_conditions.description: The school satisfies the stated public intermediate/middle classification.

inclusion_conditions.subject: unified school classification
inclusion_conditions.description: The school satisfies the stated unified-school classification.

metrics.name: Administrator e-mail addresses
metrics.definition: Administrator e-mail address values as recorded in the available administrator e-mail slots; no independent syntax, activity, or deliverability verification is requested.

time_basis.description: School opening date from 1 January 2009 through 31 December 2010, inclusive.

fields.label: Administrator e-mail addresses
fields.source_text: valid e-mail addresses of the administrator

field_states.note: The question fixes the business term; schema grounding fixes its physical classification dimension.
